changelog: **Contact permission editor (UWG § 7):** a channel the address owner withdrew themselves (the opt-out link or a recorded objection, `ownerObjected()`) is now shown as locked in the account page's editor before anyone types — a notice, with save and revoke disabled — instead of only answering a save with `owner_objected`. The rule is unchanged. New `e2e/contact-permission-editor.spec.ts` drives the editor end to end: § 7(3) refused without its reason and saved with it, an admin revocation written over again, and the locked state (API still refuses; other channels stay open).

en: On an account page, a channel the contact withdrew themselves is now marked as locked in the contact-permission editor, before you try to change it.
tr: Hesap sayfasında, kişinin kendisinin geri çektiği bir kanal artık iletişim izni düzenleyicisinde, değiştirmeye çalışmadan önce kilitli olarak gösteriliyor.
de: Auf der Account-Seite wird ein Kanal, den der Kontakt selbst widerrufen hat, im Editor für die Kontakterlaubnis jetzt als gesperrt angezeigt – bevor Sie ihn ändern wollen.
